evals.prompt: Build a new scraper for a pet supply vendor called PetMax. Their base URL is https://www.petmax-supplies.example.com. Product pages are direct PDP at /products/{sku}. Here's a product page: https://www.petmax-supplies.example.com/products/PM-12345. I need Name, Brand, and Image URLs extracted. Create the full YAML config at scrapers/configs/petmax.yaml with test_assertions and make sure it passes test mode.
evals.expected_output: A complete scrapers/configs/petmax.yaml with selectors for Name/Brand/Price/Image, workflows using Direct PDP template, validation block, test_assertions with bootstrapped expected values, and confirmation that runner.py --test-mode passes.

evals.prompt: Create a new scraper for GardenWorld, a gardening supply site. Base URL: https://www.gardenworld.example.com. They don't have direct product URLs — you must search for SKUs and click results. Search URL is /search?q={sku}. Example SKU: GW-12345. Create a scraper config that handles the search-to-PDP workflow with proper wait_for, check_no_results, conditional_skip, and extract steps.
evals.expected_output: A scrapers/configs/gardenworld.yaml using the Search→Click→PDP template, with selectors for search results and PDP fields, validation block with no_results_selectors, test_assertions, and passing test mode.

evals.prompt: The price selector in scrapers/configs/phillips.yaml is returning empty string for SKU 072705115310. The config currently uses selector '.price-current' for the Price field. Investigate the page https://shop.phillipspet.com/ccrz__ProductList?operation=quickSearch&searchText=072705115310 using playwright-cli, find the correct price selector, update the YAML (add fallbacks if needed), and verify with test mode that the assertion passes.
evals.expected_output: Updated scrapers/configs/phillips.yaml with working price selector + fallbacks, and confirmation that runner.py --test-mode passes for the given SKU.

evals.prompt: Create a new scraper for WholesalePet, a login-required wholesale site at https://www.wholesalepet.example.com. We have a credential ref called 'wholesalepet' already set up in the system. Product pages are at /product/{sku}. I need Name, UPC, and ItemNumber extracted. Include a complete login block with success_indicator and failure_indicators. Create scrapers/configs/wholesalepet.yaml.
evals.expected_output: A scrapers/configs/wholesalepet.yaml with login block, credential_refs, selectors for Name/Price/UPC/ItemNumber, workflows using Login→Direct PDP template, test_assertions, and passing test mode.

evals.prompt: The scraper config scrapers/configs/coastal.yaml exists but has no test_assertions. Add test_assertions for the SKU in test_skus[0] (or use SKU C-98765 if test_skus is empty). Bootstrap the expected values by running a dry-run extraction first, then populate test_assertions with the actual extracted Name, and Brand values. Run test mode to verify.
evals.expected_output: Updated scrapers/configs/coastal.yaml with test_assertions populated from dry-run extraction, and confirmation that runner.py --test-mode passes.

evals.prompt: Build a scraper for CloudMart, an e-commerce site at https://www.cloudmart.example.com that appears to have Cloudflare anti-bot protection. Product pages are at /item/{sku}. When you try to access it, the page may show a challenge. Create a scraper config with use_stealth: false and anti_detection enabled. Extract Name, and Image URLs. Create scrapers/configs/cloudmart.yaml.
evals.expected_output: A scrapers/configs/cloudmart.yaml with use_stealth: false, anti_detection block with blocking handling enabled, selectors for Name/Price/Image, test_assertions, and passing test mode (or clear documentation of why test mode couldn't pass due to anti-bot).
